title: The Last Island
pages:
The islands drift where the sky should be. Chorus fruit on stems that remember being plants.

The quiet here is not peace. It is the quiet of something that has already finished.

A city stands out on the rim with a ship tied to it, as if someone meant to leave and never did.

The ship has a dragon's head on the prow. He would never have kept that.

He went to the End to fix the world. I keep writing that sentence as if it explained something.

It only says where he was standing when it stopped being true.
